svg.title: Ayodhya — Measure Well plan, elevation and transverse section
svg.desc: A level crossing passes between two stepped water gauges. Its far threshold leads to Ferry Landing if Wash Steps is held. The plan is north up, uses metres, and locates two opposed thresholds.
